As the current outbreak reached  10,000 cases, with almost 5,000 deaths , Dr Jean Kaseya, director general of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), compared the outbreak to the Covid pandemic, which first took hold in China before spreading to countries across the world, claiming millions of lives, and ravaging health systems and economies.

stories.title: ANC faces anger over poor services as South Africans vote in local elections
bullet_points: Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts  The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.
The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party.
However, polls showed it getting less than a third of the vote, down from 45.6% at the  last municipal elections  in 2021 and 40.2% in  2024’s national elections .

stories.title: One dead and another missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
bullet_points: The incident took place in the same province where a grizzly attacked a group of schoolchildren last November  A mother is dead and her daughter is missing in western Canada after a suspected grizzly bear attack in the same community where a bear  attacked a group of schoolchildren  earlier in the year.

The search for her 19-year-old daughter is ongoing.
